Toppled the table-toppers!
Royal Desert Champions get the better of Yas Lions at a crucial juncture of the tournament, handing Nicholas Pooran & Co. a commanding 19-run victory.
Skipper Nicholas Pooran led from the front with a blistering 48 off 21 balls, while Dushmantha Chameera starred with the ball, returning impressive figures of 3/14 to help the Champions clinch a vital win!
